projects.title: Meraki Health
projects.description:
I work as a technical lead and individual contributor on portions of Meraki Health, a cross-product feature set that gives network administrators deep insight into the performance and experience of their wireless network. This feature set is deployed to 2.2 million networks across 6.3 million Cisco Meraki wireless access points globally, capturing data for 161 million client devices.

My individual contributor work involves developing, testing, and deploying multiple full-stack features (driving them from ideation to final delivery) with an emphasis on MVP-as-a-process. The feature development also involves interaction with the Product Management and User Experience teams to gather feedback about the features throughout the development lifecycle and prioritizing improvements with the needs of the business in mind.

My technical leadership work involves coordinating efforts of numerous engineers across multiple projects. This involves removing roadblocks for other individual contributors, providing guidance on technical designs and implementations, and as serving as a liaison between the engineering teams and project management. Additionally, I work with the Product Management and User Experience teams directly on long-term planning and roadmapping for future projects.

projects.title: Summary Report
projects.description: I worked to make substantial performance and UI improvements to Summary Report, a feature that gives network administrators the ability to see summarized usage metrics across their organization. This involved diagnosing and fixing a number of customer-facing bugs, while also implementing a number of changes that allowed Summary Report to scale to much larger customer use-cases.
